premises.text: Construction is plagued by paper-based disjointed processes and human measurement errors that waste materials and over $100B annually
premises.evidence_span: A variety of these disjointed processes combined with oftentimes simple human errors result in almost 20% of materials on a given job site being completely wasted and in the dumpster

premises.text: Recon builds a connected hardware-and-software ecosystem that streamlines measurement operations, sharing, annotation, and tasks for every worker on residential to commercial sites
premises.evidence_span: Recon Tools has set out to create a connected ecosystem of hardware and software products to significantly reduce these errors and streamline operations on the job site

premises.text: Rock Jobsite mobile app captures measurements into calculators and utilities and replaces writing measurements and office spreadsheet entry
premises.evidence_span: The Rock Jobsite app is a simple and easy to use platform that works on any mobile device, tablet, and allows everything from measurement capture, automatic putting into calculators, utilities, and other common actions

premises.text: T1 Tomahawk digital tape captures measurements on a backlit and e-paper log and auto-sends them to the app
premises.evidence_span: the T1 Tomahawk really represents the core of our hardware ecosystem and allows measurements to be captured on a large backlit display

premises.text: M1 caliper clamps onto existing saws to display the cut measurement and remove interpretation guessing
premises.evidence_span: the M1 caliper is an augmented tool that clamps onto existing saws that contractors already own, and very simple, just outputs the display and measurement on it

premises.text: QR code labels replace Sharpie notes with printable worker info and app-linked traceability
premises.evidence_span: I can print out a QR code label, which has both information printed on the label for a worker, as well as a QR code which links to the specific location in the app for traceability purposes

premises.text: GTM aims to make digital measuring tools as ubiquitous as drills and make Rock the daily app for individual jobsite workers, not only PMs
premises.evidence_span: make digital measuring tools as synonymous to a job site as a drill or a hammer

premises.text: Differentiation is end-to-end day-to-day jobsite granularity versus incremental tool OEMs and hyper-specific enterprise point tools
premises.evidence_span: Recon Tools is the only system that has the granularity needed to execute day-to-day operations on the job site
